problem:
$$
[\begin{aligned}a & b \\ -5 & -2\end{aligned}]
$$

The matrix of the bilinear form $B(x,y)=-4{x}_{1}{y}_{1}+3{x}_{1}{y}_{2}-5{x}_{2}{y}_{1}-2{x}_{2}{y}_{2}$ is given above. What is the value of $a+b?$

feedback.problem:
$$
[\begin{aligned}1 & b \\ a & \,\,-2\end{aligned}]
$$

The matrix of the bilinear form $B(x,y)={x}_{1}{y}_{1}+2{x}_{1}{y}_{2}+2{x}_{2}{y}_{1}-2{x}_{2}{y}_{2}$ is given above. What is the value of $a-b?$
feedback.worked_solution:
Each term ${a}_{ij}{x}_{i}{y}_{j}$ in the expression of the bilinear form corresponds to the entry ${a}_{ij}$ of the matrix:

$$
\begin{aligned}B(x,y) & ={x}_{1}{y}_{1}+2{x}_{1}{y}_{2}+2{x}_{2}{y}_{1}-2{x}_{2}{y}_{2} \\  & =1{x}_{1}{y}_{1}+2{x}_{1}{y}_{2} \\  & +\,2{x}_{2}{y}_{1}\,\,+(-2){x}_{2}{y}_{2}\end{aligned}
$$

    

Then, the corresponding matrix of the bilinear form is

$$
[\begin{aligned}1 & 2 \\ 2 & \,\,-2\end{aligned}].
$$

Therefore, $a=b=2.$ Finally,

$$
a-b=2-2=0.
$$
